items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: Well, I liked it in them times with Ernest Rapinoe.

ctx.x: I wondered if you could tell us a little bit about drummers. Since you were a drummer, who were the best drummers? Who did you like? And who helped you and all that on drums?
Well, I liked it in them times with Ernest Rapinoe.
What did he play on the street? Bass drum or snare?
